title: [IMP2-2] The commit stream changes on admission key rotation, so competing Commits can be stamped o
description: Review finding IMP2-2: The commit stream changes on admission key rotation, so competing Commits can be stamped on different streams (lens IMP2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:27; spec/14-jmap.md:160-162, :207, :238. Fix: Confirmed against 10-relays.md:839. The old key stays registered for a RECOMMENDED 300 s grace period after rotation, and rotation follows exactly the removal Commits (05:257). The sequencer admits both tokens in that window (14:207), so two committers for epoch N+1 can be stamped on unrelated streams that each start at 0. §14.4.4 "Closing a stream" (14:238) covers only operation streams. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
